svg.title: Flare SM70 decode-only headline
svg.desc: Decode-only, Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 on one Tesla V100 PCIe 32 GB, release binary d4ffb1fa, memory limit 31G, public prompts of 578 to 582 tokens, 2026-10-23: median decode 83.0 tok/s at 1 agent and 64.8 tok/s per agent at 4 agents. Best recorded: 90.4 tok/s at 1 agent and 70.7 per agent at 4 on 2026-10-22 with the older binary 2c792073 and internal prompts. Source: BENCHMARKS-SM70.md.
